notes.title: Tea parties, matchmaking, witchcraft, and more - introducing Wylde Society!
notes.content:
[h3]Dearest, cozy coven!
[/h3]

We’ve been bursting to share what we’ve been working on with you all! Today we are THRILLED to announce our new game, which, as many of you have hoped, is a followup to Wylde Flowers, a prequel! It’s called Wylde Society, and it’s a period drama sim about magic, social events and all things elegant.

[h3]Please enjoy our announcement trailer!
[/h3]
[previewyoutube=sVLWnmiL9f0;full][/previewyoutube]

While similar in spirit to the cosy farming of Wylde Flowers, Wylde Society swaps out the farm tools and overalls for fine china and fancy gowns. Your task is to run a magical turn-of-the-century boarding house: Sip, serve, and spill the tea, host fancy balls and charming tea parties, conduct witchy séances, and matchmake around town. With a larger cast, expanded magic, customization, stories you can influence, over-the-shoulder free-roaming, and a much larger world you can explore at will, Wylde Society is an ambitious and exciting new title for our team!

When brewing up ideas for our next game, we knew we wanted to tell more new stories in a world where players had more control. Like Wylde Flowers, meaningful storytelling is at the of Wylde Society.

We can’t wait to show you more surprises Fairhaven has in store for you. In the meantime, be sure to follow us on social media and here on Steam for regular updates! :)

[h3]More about Studio Drydock
[/h3]
Studio Drydock is making cozy games that reflect a world where everyone can belong. Their highly acclaimed debut title, Wylde Flowers, released in 2022 and was awarded Apple Arcade Game of the Year. The team is excited to introduce their next game, Wylde Society.
